system.description:
Secret (a kata, held by one living student at a time).

Study: with its holder, if the holder agrees; 12 weeks, DC 15, a Dexterity or Wisdom check.

Teaches: the Unique feat The Last Form: once per encounter, as part of an attack, declare it; the attack has Advantage, and on a hit it is a critical hit and the target makes a Fortitude save (10 + half your level + Strength or Dexterity modifier) or is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

  • It is on no Path, uses no feat level and isn't your Trained Feat for the Tier; once per character.
  • A dying master's final kata, passed from one student to one other and never written down.
  • Bharash says he has seen it once.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
